name: Golod
source: Semyon led the ordinary life of a typical hermit. But one day everything in his life changes. The evil fate throws our hero into a camp on the brink of survival. Food supplies are running out, communication with the outside world is not working, and people are disappearing to God knows where. Will Semyon be able to get out of here alive or will this place be stronger than him?
